research.title: Probability Calibration Under Structured Covariate Missingness
bullets: Formulated a research question on calibration under changing missingness patterns and led development of a missingness-conditioned shrinkage calibrator.
Evaluated calibration error and predictive loss under simulated missingness mechanisms, comparing pooled calibration against pattern-specific alternatives.

research.title: Stabilizing Weighted Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated the question of how density-ratio estimation instability affects conformal prediction and led development of an adaptive weight-truncation procedure.
Designed synthetic and tabular-data evaluations examining empirical coverage, interval width, and sensitivity to estimated importance weights across covariate shifts.

publications.title: Adaptive Importance-Weight Truncation for Stable Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate entries within existing processing routines.
Added regression tests for parsing and transformation behavior, investigated reported failures, and documented expected handling of malformed input records.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized predictors and cross-validation for selecting regularization strength on synthetic and tabular datasets.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across correlated feature settings, checking sensitivity to sample splitting and regularization choices.

projects.title: Approximate Inference for Bayesian Logistic Regression
bullets: Implemented Laplace approximation and mean-field variational inference for Bayesian logistic regression, using matched priors and preprocessing across comparisons.
Compared predictive log loss, posterior uncertainty, and convergence behavior on classification datasets, examining sensitivity to initialization and prior scale.

projects.title: Density Estimation with Mixture and Kernel Models
bullets: Implemented expectation-maximization for Gaussian mixture models and kernel density estimation, selecting model complexity through held-out likelihood comparisons.
Evaluated density estimates on synthetic distributions with overlapping modes, tracking initialization sensitivity, covariance regularization effects, and bandwidth-dependent smoothing.

projects.title: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals for Regression Estimates
bullets: Implemented percentile, basic, and bias-corrected bootstrap intervals for regression coefficients, with reusable resampling routines and checks against analytic standard errors.
Compared empirical coverage and interval length under skewed noise and heteroscedasticity, distinguishing pairs resampling from residual resampling assumptions.
